title: The Very Careful Coffee
scene: You buy a takeaway coffee on the way to the station and handle it with exaggerated care. After getting it safely onto the train, one small movement turns all that caution into a slightly public embarrassment.
sceneJa: 駅へ向かう途中でテイクアウトのコーヒーを買い、かなり慎重に運ぶ。無事に電車まで持ち込めたと思った矢先、ちょっとした動きでカップを蹴飛ばし、妙に注目を集めることになる。

questions.question: Which boundary is most natural?
options: I even avoided the crowded escalator / and took the stairs instead / just to be safe
I even avoided / the crowded escalator and / took the stairs instead just / to be safe
I even / avoided the crowded / escalator and took / the stairs instead just to be safe
questions.explanation: The first chunk gives the avoided option, the second gives the alternative action, and the final chunk gives the reason for being extra cautious.

questions.question: What does ‘just to be safe’ mean here?
options: To avoid even a small unnecessary risk
questions.explanation: ‘Just to be safe’ means taking an extra precaution even when it may not be strictly necessary.

questions.question: Why is the ending ironic?
options: The coffee spills even though the lid is secure
The coffee survives, but the speaker’s careful behaviour still ends in embarrassment
The speaker forgets to drink the coffee
questions.explanation: The speaker spent the whole trip protecting the coffee, yet the coffee is fine while the speaker is the one who loses composure.

speak: Start carefully and matter-of-factly. Let a little satisfaction enter at ‘I was rather pleased’ and ‘congratulated myself,’ then shift quickly at ‘accidentally kicked the cup.’ Read ‘with as much dignity as I could manage’ with restrained embarrassment, and keep the final line dry rather than jokey.
review: Story flow: caution → growing confidence → small accident → public embarrassment → dry reversal. Useful chunks: ‘just to be safe,’ ‘congratulate yourself on,’ and ‘with as much ... as I could manage.’ The humour works because the object being protected stays perfectly fine while the careful person becomes the actual problem.
